candidates.claim: The new Neutron pagination loop in ports.list (and routers.list) has no upper bound on pages or accumulated items. The `visited` set only stops a repeated identical URL, so a `next` link whose marker keeps changing (or a very large project) makes one tRPC query issue unbounded sequential Neutron requests and buffer every result in BFF memory before the network/subnet lookups. Any authenticated user can trigger it by opening the list page.
candidates.evidence: git show 86a355a8:packages/aurora/src/server/Network/routers/portsRouter.ts: loop pushes `...pagePorts` into `ports` until `nextPageUrl` returns undefined or a URL repeats; no max-page or max-item cap. Same pattern in routersRouter.ts list. nextPageUrl (requestHelpers.ts) reuses only the query from Neutron's absolute `next` href against the fixed base path, so there is no host/path injection; the concern is only resource exhaustion.
candidates.precedent: Both ports and routers list share the identical loop.
